subject: human face
title: What If You Had No Eyebrows? People Might Not Recognize You

scenes.text: What if you lost your eyebrows? Friends might not recognize you. Hiding your eyes matters less.
Scientists at MIT showed volunteers photos of famous faces.
In some, the eyes were digitally erased. In others, only the eyebrows were removed.
The faces without eyebrows were harder to recognize than the faces without eyes.
Eyebrows frame the face and carry much of your expression: surprise, anger, doubt.
They also keep sweat, rain and dust out of your eyes. Two strips of hair, working as a gutter and a name tag.

description:
What if you had no eyebrows? In a study in the journal Perception, MIT researchers found famous faces were harder to recognize with the eyebrows removed than with the eyes removed.
Eyebrows are key for facial expression and recognition, and they also help keep sweat, dust and rain out of the eyes.
